data.name: Feign Innocence
data.description: The phantom thief seems so innocent that it is hard to believe he was involved in wrongdoing. Within his area of renown, this provides a nonmagical effect identical to the innocence spell (Advanced Player's Guide p. 229.)

raw_tokens.value: 2,CATEGORY=Special Ability,Phantom Thief Talent ~ Renown,Phantom Thief ~ Broad Education

The phantom thief seems so innocent that it is hard to believe he was involved in wrongdoing. Within his area of renown, this provides a nonmagical effect identical to the innocence spell (Advanced Player's Guide p. 229.)
